name: Fluent Forms
notes: Four forms named for what they are for. With FluentCRM active, each sends people to the FluentCRM list named after the form (Website Contact Form, Website Booking Form, Website Newsletter Subscription Form, Data Subject Access Request Form), so a contact’s lists show where they came from, and ticks and choices on the form add tags: the newsletter tick box adds Website Newsletter Subscriber, and the access request’s “Data Subject Access Type(s)” adds Customer / Client, Supplier, Contractor, Employee or Website User. The Discovery Call Form also fills the Company, Role and Website contact fields. The lists and tags are added with the forms when they are missing, so it does not matter whether FluentCRM’s starter data is added first. Forms added while FluentCRM is inactive have no feed: remove and add them again once it is active, or set one up under the form’s Integrations. Phone numbers and the access request’s proof of identity and address uploads need Fluent Forms Pro; without it the forms are added without them, so ask for proof when you reply to a request. Notifications and styles are Fluent Forms’ own defaults; set the consent wording and the confirmation messages to suit the site. The access request form keeps entries for 10 years and then deletes them.
